source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: 1020 changes many console.error calls from string concatenation or interpolation of the exception to a context string plus the exception object. The accepted account manager and SMTP settings code keep that form. Preserve the error object when logging a caught exception so its details remain available to the logger. Scope this to caught errors; MimeMessageUtils deliberately passes e.stack separately, so this evidence does not justify a ban on explicit stack logging.
title: Pass the caught error as a separate logging argument
